scope: Audit the 1960/1961 Teachers' Organization Bill lineage after pass 146, distinguishing official archival metadata from later synthesis and refusing same-title identity inference.

findings.evidence: National Archives 국무회의 안건 목록집 I lists item 287 교육공무원법 중 개정 법률(안), 3 pages, and item 288 교직단체법(안), 15 pages, both Education Ministry, 37th meeting, 1960-10-08, BA0084253.

National Archives cabinet search lists 교육공무원법중 개정법률(제25회) and 교직단체법(제25회), both deliberated 1961-06-21. The search result leaves proposing agency blank, so ministry attribution is not yet proven from this record.

KDemo later synthesis says the Chang Myon-government bill was abandoned on 1961-02-12, while official National Archives metadata shows a same-title bill again on 1961-06-21. This is not a contradiction if the June item was a new draft, revival, carry-over, or archival reclassification; text and disposition records are required.

method_corrections: Do not state that the 1961 bill was proposed by the Education Ministry until the original item or other official metadata supplies the proposer.
Do not state that the 1961 bill was enacted, adopted, or approved merely because it appears in cabinet deliberation metadata.
Do not state that the 1960 and 1961 bills were identical, revived, or continuous until their texts/document numbers are compared.
Treat the pairing of an Education Public Officials Act amendment and Teachers' Organization Bill in both 1960 and 1961 as a continuity signal only.
